name: Wuji Hand 2
summary: Wuji Hand 2 is a five-finger, non-tactile robotic-hand prototype for research, robot integration and human-robot interaction. Its 20 independently actuated direct-drive joints support backdrivability, MIT force-position control and a 1 kHz control rate across 20 axes. The manufacturer provides Ethernet connectivity, SDK interfaces and simulation models. Passive protective skin must remain fitted during operation and does not provide tactile sensing. Specifications retain their documented Beta hardware configuration and measurement conditions.

Specifications retain their documented Beta hardware configuration and measurement conditions.
